newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading in HK Telecom, CITIC resumes.
newsitem.headline: Trading in HK Telecom, CITIC resumes.

text.p: Trading in shares of Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd and CITIC Pacific Ltd resumed at the start of the Friday afternoon session after being suspended in the morning, the two companies said in statements issued through the Hong Kong stock exchange.
Trading in the companies' shares was suspended on Friday morning at their own request pending an announcement.

In separate statements, the two companies said CITIC Pacific had agreed in principle to sell 904.69 million shares, or 7.74 percent, in Hong Kong Telecom to China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd for about HK$11.4 billion.
CITIC Pacific said the agreement had been reached on Thursday night but negotiations were still proceeding and no agreement had been signed.
CITIC shares were up HK$0.60 to HK$44.10 in late trade while Hongkong Telecom shares fell HK$0.45 to HK$14.55.
